name: Columbo's Mystery Capers
summary: Columbo's Mystery Capers is a puzzle-solving mystery game tying into the eponymous detective TV series with Peter Falk as Lt. Columbo. As a police investigator you are presented with a crime scene and need to figure out what's happened and who's the culprit. To do so you need to search for various points of interest by tapping the display, just like in point and click adventure games, only everything here happens on the same screen.
